mode: headless Chromium; native servers; no image build
scope: Local OCL ZIP import/history and OWA module package lifecycle

flows.name: O3 local configuration and remote policy
flows.action: Open /openmrs/spa/ocl; inspect Subscription and Import tabs.
flows.expected: Local configuration is visible; remote import is disabled with its explanation; local file upload remains available.

flows.name: Direct remote import rejected without new history
flows.action: Send JSON POST to openconceptlab/import and compare history before and after.
flows.expected: HTTP 400 explains the offline policy. No import row or item is created.

flows.name: Empty selection and invalid ZIP remain usable
flows.action: Press Import from file without a file; then upload invalid.zip.
flows.expected: Validation is visible, loading ends, and a valid file can be chosen afterward.

flows.name: Offline ZIP creates concepts and set mapping
flows.action: Upload valid.zip containing two concepts and a CONCEPT-SET mapping; wait for completion and read concepts back.
flows.expected: The real importer persists both UUIDs, names and set membership. History reports three processed items.

flows.name: Repeat upload is idempotent
flows.action: Upload the same valid.zip again and read both concepts and set members.
flows.expected: No duplicate concept or set member is created. Existing identities survive.

flows.name: O3 previous imports and expanded results survive reload
flows.action: Open Previous Imports, expand the new import, then hard reload.
flows.expected: History and persisted result counts remain available after reload.

flows.name: OWA upload and history work without subscription
flows.action: Open /openmrs/owa/openconceptlab/index.html#/ without a saved subscription.
flows.expected: Local ZIP upload and previous history are visible; remote subscription import remains disabled.

flows.name: OWA updated concept persists after reload
flows.action: In the OWA, upload update.zip with the same concept UUID and an updated exported name.
flows.expected: The concept name changes, readback confirms it, and the updated value survives a reload.

flows.name: Item error detail stays local
flows.action: Upload errors.zip with an unsupported datatype; open its import detail.
flows.expected: A stored item error explains the unsupported datatype. Concept identity and error text are visible without an external link.

flows.name: Ignore item errors persists without remote import
flows.action: Acknowledge the failed import’s errors, then reload the detail.
flows.expected: The error item is IGNORED_ERROR and acknowledgement persists. No remote import starts.

flows.name: Empty export is a completed zero-item import
flows.action: Upload empty.zip containing empty concept and mapping arrays.
flows.expected: A completed zero-item import is shown; an empty export is not fabricated into sample data.

flows.name: Browser makes no external service requests
flows.action: Keep the browser network interceptor active during every OCL flow.
flows.expected: Zero external HTTP(S) attempts and zero browser page errors. Separate backend sentinels cover direct and scheduled remote entry points.

flows.name: Manage Apps lists installed local apps and offline policy
flows.action: Open Administration → Open Web Apps Module → Manage Apps.
flows.expected: The two shipped apps are listed and the external-store policy is visible.

flows.name: Empty upload and Clear are usable
flows.action: Press Upload without a selected file; select valid.zip, then press Clear.
flows.expected: No app is installed by the empty submission. Clear resets the file selection and upload remains usable.

flows.name: Valid ZIP installation is listed after reload
flows.action: Upload valid.zip for QA Offline Packaged App; reload Manage Apps.
flows.expected: A real persisted version 1.0 package appears alongside the unchanged shipped apps.

flows.name: Launch uses real HTML CSS JS and local REST
flows.action: Launch the installed package from its app row.
flows.expected: Its packaged HTML, CSS and JavaScript load. A relative manifest read leads to the local OpenMRS REST session endpoint.

flows.name: Nested navigation and reload preserve assets
flows.action: Follow Nested page inside the package and hard reload.
flows.expected: The nested HTML page still loads from the installed package.

flows.name: Replacement publishes v2 and removes old files
flows.action: Upload update.zip for version 2.0 of the same app, then launch it.
flows.expected: Version 2.0 appears once. Its changed page loads and the obsolete v1 file returns 404.

flows.name: Malformed archives preserve installed v2
flows.action: Submit invalid, empty, missing-manifest, missing-launch, malformed-manifest, traversal and symlink ZIPs.
flows.expected: Every invalid install is rejected without 500. The valid v2 package and its files remain intact.

flows.name: Settings persist a custom local base URL
flows.action: Save App Base URL as /offlineapps; reload settings and launch using both prefixes.
flows.expected: The stored setting survives reload. Both /openmrs/offlineapps/ and canonical /openmrs/owa/ serve the app.

flows.name: Cancel deletion leaves the app usable
flows.action: Start deleting the owned app, then cancel.
flows.expected: The app remains installed and usable.

flows.name: Confirmed deletion removes both canonical and custom URLs
flows.action: Delete the owned app and confirm; request its old launch URL under both prefixes.
flows.expected: The app leaves the catalogue, its files are removed, and both URLs return 404.

flows.name: Remote installation is rejected without fetching or installing
flows.action: POST a package URL to ws/rest/owa/installapp.
flows.expected: HTTP 400 explains that external downloads are disabled. No package is downloaded or installed.

flows.name: Restore settings and leave shipped apps unchanged
flows.action: Restore the captured settings, reload, and compare the shipped app catalogue.
flows.expected: Original effective settings and both shipped apps remain. The original blank base is restored after the UI’s stock /owa normalization.

flows.name: No external requests or page errors
flows.action: Inspect intercepted network requests and browser errors after the complete OWA lifecycle.
flows.expected: Zero external HTTP(S) attempts and zero page errors.

focusedChecks.referenceOcl: REST, HTTP client and scheduler sentinels; local settings persistence
focusedChecks.referenceOwa: install, replacement, seven invalid ZIPs, staging cleanup, deletion and remote request sentinel
